_comment: HIMMEL-2348 deliverable 2. Machine-readable mirror of docs/setup/operator-profile-tbd-delta.md's table, keyed by the doc's OWN row number (column 1) rather than by delta.* path -- a path key can hold only one entry, and row 4 cites TWO paths (profile.bridge.installPersistence and delta.cadences.extraArmedTasks, the same path row 2 also cites), so a path-keyed map cannot represent both. `entries[N]` -> {label, ticket, paths[]} where paths is every delta.*/profile.* path the row's 'Captured how' column cites. `himmelctl gaps` renders group (b) (reference-only, no wizard question can produce it yet) from `entries`. Checked structurally against the doc by test-wizard-gaps.sh case f: every doc row number must appear here with a matching ticket, and vice versa -- ROW-LEVEL, not a path/ticket set union, so a dropped row fails even when its path/ticket happen to also appear via another row. Don't hand-wave this back in sync.

1.label: Armed cadences beyond the pipeline family (graphmap, qmd, drift-fix, codex-sweep, ggs, repo-sync)

2.label: Scheduled tasks that exist but aren't in any of the 7 cadence ids (HIMMEL-BootPreflight, HIMMEL-ForkResync when armed)

3.label: Observability registry stack (~/.himmel/observability.json — flows[], expected_tasks[], expected_disabled_tasks[])

4.label: Bridge persistence artifact detail (the actual HimmelTelegramBridge scheduled task / telegram-bridge.service unit, beyond the yes/no installPersistence answer)

5.label: Guardrail env posture — which SESSION-ONLY bypass/threshold vars are set in the invoking shell

6.label: Codex/hermes profile install completion (auth provisioned, model pulled) beyond the lane opt-in consent

7.label: Handover registry entries — repo names + count in ~/.claude/handover/registry.json

8.label: HUD config (claude-hud.json presence, its top-level key names, whether statusLine.command references it)

9.label: Repo-root .env key names beyond the generated secrets-manifest block

10.label: Lane readiness gates (passesRequired probation counters) and the full dormant-lane roster

11.label: Plugin drift from the lean floor (enabledBeyondTemplate / templateTrueButDisabled)

12.label: alwaysOn inference gap — inferred from armed cadences/bridge persistence, never asked-and-recorded
